references.text: The same context where a man accuses his wife of not having been a virgin and brings false charges against her.
The girl's parents shall bring the proof of her virginity to the elders of the city, which is the same procedure described.
The consequence if the accusation of lack of virginity turned out to be true, as opposed to the false accusation.
Tamar was accused of adultery but proved her innocence by presenting evidence, a similar theme of false accusations and proof.
Proverbs warns against false accusations and emphasizes the importance of fair judgment at the city gate.
Laws concerning virgins and the bride price, which provide background for the significance of virginity in the context of marriage.
